notes.zh: 统一跨工具显示、相机、书签及文件出口；修复触屏项目树、投影切换和后台保存问题。改善手机排布、原生高斯参数提交与横屏漫游。已有 App 可热更新网页部分；原生界面修复请安装本版完整 APK。
notes.en: Unify shared display, camera, bookmarks and file saving. Fix touch project-tree interactions, projection switching and background saves. Improve mobile layouts and native Gaussian controls. Web changes support hot updates; native UI fixes require this complete APK.
